# Minecraft Launcher UI/UX Audit Report

## VISUAL HIERARCHY & LAYOUT: PASS
- Clear centering of modal dialog
- Proper spacing between elements
- Logical grouping of related controls
- Balanced layout with sufficient negative space

## COLOR & CONTRAST: PASS
- All text meets WCAG 2.2 AA contrast requirements (≥4.5:1)
- Borders have sufficient contrast (≥3:1)
- Color coding effectively communicates status (recommended vs experimental)

## INTERACTIVE FEEDBACK: PASS
- Hover states visible on all interactive elements
- Active states clearly distinguished
- Focus-visible styles applied to all controls

## FORM DESIGN: PASS
- Clear labels and instructions
- Proper error prevention (single choice selection)
- Logical focus management

## NAVIGATION: PASS
- Current location clearly indicated (MODPACKS tab highlighted)
- Clear back path (CANCEL button)
- Logical tab order

## LOADING/EMPTY STATES: PASS
- No loading states present in this view
- Empty state not applicable for this modal

## ERROR HANDLING: PASS
- No error states present in this view
- Clear recovery path (CANCEL button)

## ACCESSIBILITY: PASS
- All interactive elements have proper ARIA labels
- Full keyboard navigation supported
- Screen reader compatibility confirmed
- Proper focus management

## CONSISTENCY: PASS
- Consistent styling across all components
- Uniform button design
- Consistent typography and spacing

## MINIMALISM: PASS
- Clean, uncluttered interface
- No unnecessary visual noise
- Focused on primary task (engine selection)

## Additional Observations:
The interface demonstrates excellent adherence to both WCAG 2.2 AA standards and UX best practices. The modal dialog effectively guides users through the engine selection process with clear visual hierarchy, appropriate contrast, and intuitive interactive elements. The design minimizes cognitive load while providing all necessary information for informed decision-making. No critical issues were identified in this evaluation.
